metadata.description: Harmonia teaches kids the basics of music theory in a clear and engaging way. Led by Harmonia, each episode introduces key concepts like pitch, tempo, rhythm, and dynamics using real sound examples and simple explanations. It’s perfect for curious kids ages 5–10, whether they’re new to music or already learning an instrument. The series helps children build a strong foundation in music. Parents will love how it supports listening skills, focus, and confidence while making music fun!
